output.reason: [ev-e24f6e836412] says an ApplicationSet is affected when `applyNestedSelectors` is unset or `false` and it has one or more nested selectors. Its log check (`ignoring nested selector`) and remediation describe the same condition. The proposal gets the meaning right, but it puts an `undecidable` leaf inside a `resource` node. Only field, text-line and ref leaves may sit inside a resource, so I keep the field test under the ApplicationSet resource and move `undecidable` up to an `all` at environment level. The evidence still does not give the field path of nested selectors, so that part stays undecidable.

correction.statement: In Argo CD 3.0 the ApplicationSet `spec.applyNestedSelectors` field is ignored and nested selectors are always applied. Affected environments have an ApplicationSet with `applyNestedSelectors` unset or false that also has one or more nested selectors. Whether nested selectors are present cannot be checked statically, because the evidence does not give their field path.

of.needed: whether that ApplicationSet has one or more nested selectors (the evidence does not give the field path of nested selectors); the 'ignoring nested selector' line in the ApplicationSet controller logs is the upstream detection signal
